About Us | FV Bush Camping
top of page
ABOUT US
Francvillers Station is a family-owned working sheep, goat and cattle property.
​
After years of hosting the odd group of people - friends of friends or distant acquaintances - it got us thinking. There must be a reason they keep coming back.
​
We offer seclusion, only taking five to six self-sufficient groups at a time, ensuring complete privacy. No shared space, just the real outback. Access to the campsites is weather dependent.

FAQs | FV Bush Camping
top of page
FAQs
What is your cancellation policy?
As we are a small business, we depend on maximising occupancy and cancellations often result in an empty campsite due to booking lead times. Please contact us immediately if you wish to vary or cancel your booking.
We offer a full refund 3 days before check in, any cancellations after this time are non-refundable.
Please be aware that there is a fee for any modified bookings.
Are you pet friendly?
Yes, however all dogs must be kept on a lead at all times.
What is vehicle access like?
In order to get to the property, you will need to travel 28km south of Cunnamulla on the Mitchell Highway towards Bourke. The roads into the campsites are 2WD accessible, however caution needs to be used as some roads are weather permitting. 4WD is highly recommended.
The speed limit on our property is 20km/h, please respect this to minimise dust disturbance, for your own safety, and for the integrity of the road.
Please stick to the access road only and do not drive into the paddocks. This will only cause damage to your vehicle and to our paddock.
​
Please watch out for our stock and wildlife and drive to the conditions.
Where exactly is Francvillers Bush Camping?
Francvillers is located 28km south of Cunnamulla on the Mitchell Highway towards Bourke, an easy 25min drive.
How safe/secluded are the campsites?
We don't have any predatory animals and all campsites are set in off the highway. There is a combination lock on each gate entrance to ensure the safety of our guests. You'll receive this code via email in your welcome pack.
What amenities do you offer?
There are wood fired hot tubs at some campsites Campers must be self-sufficient as there are on onsite showers or toilets.
Is there phone reception?
No, our property is right on the edge of phone service. Disconnect and enjoy the serenity!
How many campsites are there?
Six in total; two that are 100m apart in Lake Paddock while all the other sites are all kilometres away from each other.
What time is check on and check out?
Check in: 2pm
Check out: 10am
What is there to do nearby?
- Visit the artesian Time Tunnel, Art Gallery and Museum
- Take a selfie with the Cunnamulla Fella
- Spot some wildlife on the Warrego River Walk
- Relax at the Cunnamulla Hot Springs
- Watch the All Aboard Film at the Railway station
- Take a drive to Charlotte Plains to explore their working sheep farm
- Walk through the Cunnamulla Bushlands
- Walk the Heritage Trail (maps available at the Visitor Information Centre)
- Selfie at the iconic Cunnamulla sign
- Explore the Art Trail
Kayaking on the Warrego River
- Birdwatch
- Eat and shop in Cunnamulla
- Catch a fish from the Warrego River
- Visit the Community Markets which are on the 2nd Sunday each month
- Play lawn bowls
- Have a hit of golf
- Attend the local races
- Rejuvenate in Artesian Mud baths at Eulo which is 1.5hr drive

Terms and Conditions
These Terms and Conditions apply to bookings you make with us over the phone, via email, in-person or online. All rates are quoted in AUD and are inclusive of GST (Goods & Services Tax).  Our ABN number is 80101767482.  All prices are subject to availability.

Your credit card details will be required to confirm your booking. Please note that your credit card details are taken as a guarantee of your booking.  Full payment will be charged to your credit card within 10 days prior to check-in. Most major credit cards are accepted.

A valid Credit Card is required at time of booking and a valid Credit Card must be presented at time of check-in.

No Party Policy
For the benefit of all guests, Francvillers Bush Camping has a strict no party policy. In the event that any campsite/guest is identified as having a party, the property reserves the right to immediately request all occupants of the campsite to vacate the premises. In addition, the registered guests will be required to settle the account prior to departure for any expense resulting from additional cleaning of the campsite and any required repairs.

Identification
Upon arrival Guests may be asked to provide valid photographic identification for security purposes. The booking must be under the name of the person checking in. In addition, the Guest must also provide a credit card in the name of the photographic ID.

All guests under the age of 18 years must be accompanied by a parent/guardian/responsible adult over the age of 18 years.  The property has the right to refuse any booking when the legal guardian over 18 years cannot provide current photo ID if requested on check-in.

We will make all attempts to satisfy special requests, however cannot guarantee.

Dietary Requirements
Any requests for special dietary requirement need to be advised more than 48 hours prior to arrival and are subject to availability.

No-Shows / Failure to Cancel
Each booking at Francvillers Bush Camping is subject to a Cancellation Policy. Failure to check in on the reserved arrival date will incur a 100% penalty charge. If guests choose to shorten their stay or check out early a penalty charge will apply, as detailed in the Cancellation Policy associated with the rate booked.

Francvillers Bush Camping provides such links only as a convenience to you and the inclusion of any link does not imply endorsement, investigation or verification by Francvillers Bush Camping of the linked website or any information contained in it.
